title: Click counter
hints: Look at the two handlers that change the count more than once or after a wait: the one behind Add 3 and the one behind Add 1 after saving.

Both handlers work out the new count from the number they saw when the click happened. Three updates in one click all start from that same old number, and a save that finishes later starts from the number on screen before it began, so clicks made in between are lost.
When the next count depends on the previous one, give the setter a function that receives the latest count and returns the next one, instead of a value computed from the count your handler captured.
